```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : (A ∪ B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro h
    split
    · contrapose! h
      apply mem_union.1
      exact h
    · contrapose! h
      apply mem_union.2
      exact h
  · intro h
    split
    · contrapose! h.1
      apply mem_union.1
      exact h.1
    · contrapose! h.2
      apply mem_union.2
      exact h.2
```
